name: Move MongoDB data to Snowflake
steps:
**MongoDB to Snowflake**

1.  From the DataSources section select MongoDB as the data source.
2.  Select your added Snowflake data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your MongoDB database, similar to the process described in this [Documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/databases/mongodb/setup.html) page.
4.  Click on [\+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/mongodb/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
